items.headline: State of Iowa seeking nonprofits to disburse K-12 scholarships funded by federal tax credit
items.summary: The Education Freedom Tax Credit program allows taxpayers to claim a credit for contributing to student scholarships.

items.headline: Emergency winter shelter set to open in Moline this December
items.summary: The shelter will be located at 3906 25th St., the former location of Winnie's Place. Officials said it can accommodate at least 30 people.

items.headline: What to know about the judges on Iowa ballots
items.summary: Three Court of Appeals judges will appear on all Iowans' ballots on Nov. 3. 84 trial judges are also standing for retention.

items.headline: Ice painted with names of current and former military members ahead of Quad City Storm game
items.summary: Saturday's game is Salute to Military Night. Community members painted the names of those who currently serve or have served in the U.S. Armed Forces.

items.headline: Dixon, Illinois police asking for help locating suspect in home invasion
items.summary: 38-year-old Coty McCluskey is charged with home invasion, aggravated domestic battery and domestic battery stemming from an incident on Saturday night.

items.headline: Iowa early voting surges 37% amid long lines and party efforts to sway independents
items.summary: Early voting in Iowa has seen a 37% surge compared to four years ago, with more than 374,000 ballots already cast.

items.headline: Federal court issues preliminary injunction in Satanic Temple Iowa lawsuit
items.summary: The injunction will allow TST Iowa to host its planned holiday event at the state capitol in December.

items.headline: 8 Iowa hospitals receive funding for opioid alternative program from attorney general's office
items.summary: The Billion Pill Pledge supports community hospitals in best practice surgical protocols and educates providers on non-opiate pain management options.

items.headline: Republican Zach Lahn and Democrat Rob Sand clash in hopes of securing open Iowa governor's seat
items.summary: The 2026 midterm election presents the first Iowa gubernatorial race since 2018 without Gov. Kim Reynolds as the incumbent.

items.headline: 18-year-old arrested after Moline police recover gun at Halloween party
items.summary: Police said more than 100 teens were at a party in the 1500 block of 19th Avenue on Saturday night when they received reports of a person with a gun.

items.headline: On economic development, Pritzker, Bailey are miles apart
items.summary: Gov. Pritzker touts progress, but Illinois still lags the nation in key economic metrics. Bailey sees lower taxes as the key.

items.headline: Rock Island County sheriff candidates address pressing issues before Election Day
items.summary: Both Democrat candidate Marcus Herbert and Republican candidate Jamie Shoemaker spoke on homelessness and Flock cameras in the Quad Cities.
